findings.title: swapBack has no TWAP floor: a borrower can drain principal through a self-sandwich
findings.description: swapBack is bounded only by the borrower-supplied minAmountOut (> 0). Swap entry and forced swap-back are TWAP-bounded; voluntary exit is not.
findings.impact: Lender loses principal down to deposit + capped insurance draw; PoC: owed 10.02, paid 4.58.
findings.rootCause: The slippage floor on the exit path is chosen by the party it should constrain.
findings.recommendation: Floor minAmountOut at TWAP x (1 - twapToleranceBps) in swapBack; fix the fee tier once an asset is held.

findings.title: Insurance pays unpaid interest at a lender-chosen, unbounded APR; one wallet acting as both lender and borrower drains the reserve
findings.description: Insurance draws cover principal + accruedFee; aprBps is unbounded and lender == borrower is allowed, so a 60-second loan at a huge APR draws drawCapBps x principal from the pool each cycle.
findings.impact: Any per-asset reserve can be drained by one KYC'd wallet; PoC drains 5 WETH in 5 cycles.
findings.rootCause: The lender sets the size of the insured claim.
findings.recommendation: Insure principal only, or cap the insured APR, enforce a minimum insured term and require lender != borrower.

findings.title: Borrower can make forced swap-back revert at will, getting a free extension of a non-liquidating position
findings.description: A dust swap() overwrites swapFeeTierOf for the whole held balance; settlement then sells everything through a thin pool and reverts on the TWAP floor. Donating the held asset beyond pool depth has the same effect.
findings.impact: Lender principal locked past term with no bound; borrower holds a free option to unblock settlement when favourable.
findings.rootCause: The fee tier is chosen by the last swap, and the exit sells the whole balance in one call.
findings.recommendation: Pin the fee tier at first entry; check entry impact against the full post-swap balance in the exit direction.
